column1: # Merkle tree branch vectors. Oracle: risc0-zkp 1.2.6 MerkleTreeProver/MerkleTreeVerifier
# (Poseidon2 suite). Per tree: proof = full IOP word stream (top row digests, then per
# query: row elems + path digests); root = 8 RAW digest words; query:<idx> -> canonical
# row values, where <idx> = random_bits(log2_ceil(rows)) drawn from the transcript rng
# AFTER the root commit. Negative vectors are oracle-confirmed rejects:
# badword:<word_idx>,<xor> (xor one proof word) | truncate:<words kept> |
